subject: Biotechnology
title: Designer Babies and Enhancement
description: A fast breakdown of Designer Babies and Enhancement for builders.

hook.text: Cure disease or enhance intelligence? The line between therapy and enhancement blurs as gene editing advances.

buildup.text: Editing out sickle cell disease is therapy — editing for taller height or higher IQ crosses into enhancement territory.

discovery.text: Intelligence involves thousands of genes each with tiny effects — designer babies are scientifically impractical today.

twist.text: If enhancement becomes possible, only the wealthy could afford it — genetic inequality could become permanent and heritable.

climax.text: The Nuffield Council said germline editing might be ethical if it promotes welfare and does not increase inequality.

punchline.text: Cure or upgrade? Society must decide before the technology decides for us.

quiz.question: Why are designer babies with enhanced intelligence currently impractical?
options: CRISPR cannot edit genes related to brain function
Intelligence involves thousands of genes with tiny individual effects, making meaningful enhancement scientifically unfeasible
No country allows research on genes related to intelligence
